version: LOCK 82 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - Monday and Thursday
builds_on: LOCK 2 prayer, LOCK 3 Idris, LOCK 6 regulars, LOCK 34 runner. Private counters go to the Journal; worship never earns trust.

a.text: Before Fajr the innkeeper leaves out dates and water for anyone fasting. Mondays and Thursdays, the old men of the market fast.

choices.label: Eat and make the intention to fast
